title: 3D Floorplan property description (schema version 1)
description: Describes a plot and a building. POST it to /api/import (or paste it into 'Houses & backup' > 'Import house from JSON') to build a new house. All lengths are metres.

plot.description: The plot (Grundstück). Same coordinate frame as the building after 'origin' is applied.

objects.description: Garden objects: lawn, terrace, path, tree, bush, fence, pool, car ... Coordinates are plot coordinates.

origin.description: Where the building's (0,0) lies on the plot. Default [0,0].

footprint.description: Outline of the building (wall centre line). Used by every floor that has no footprint of its own.

roof.description: Adds a roof on top of the building.

point.description: [x, z] in metres. x runs east (right), z runs south (down).

polygon.description: Closed polygon, listed in order. The last point is NOT repeated.

box.description: optional: roof base in metres instead of the automatic size (before the overhang)

dormers.description: Roof dormers (Gauben). Ignored on a flat roof.

pos.description: Position along the ridge, 0 = start, 1 = end.

hw.description: Height of the front wall in metres (limited so that the dormer stays under the ridge).

eave.description: Distance of the front wall from the eave, measured along the slope's floor plan, in metres.

parts.description: Further roofs on the same building, e.g. a flat roof over an annex. Each one needs a box (its base in metres) and may sit on top of a lower floor (level).

area.description: Home Assistant area id the room belongs to.

terrace.description: Roof terrace / open area: no roof above it, a railing along every edge without a wall.

walls.description: Optional. If present, EXACTLY these walls are used (nothing is derived from rooms). Without it, walls are derived from footprint and room outlines; edges shared by two rooms become one inner wall.

openings.description: Doors and windows, each placed on the wall nearest to 'at'.

opening.description: A door or window. Give 'type' or a 'preset'. Placement: 'at' [x,z] (nearest wall) or, inside an explicit wall, 'pos' (metres from point a).

y.description: Height above the floor in metres (default depends on the type).

entity.description: Home Assistant entity id, e.g. light.wohnzimmer

ledEntity.description: Backlight entity of a tv / tv_wall.

motionEntity.description: Motion sensor of a camera: its field-of-view cone turns red while it is on.

fov.description: Field of view of a camera in degrees (0 = no cone).

range.description: Reach of a camera's field of view in metres.

hideModel.description: Invisible in live mode, the light keeps shining.

panels.description: Only for type nanoleaf: [{s: tri|tri2|hex|sq|bar, x, y, r}] in metres / degrees.

pts.description: Only for type ledring: corner points [x, z] in metres, relative to the device position.

closed.description: Only for type ledring: last point connects back to the first (default true).

segs.description: Only for type ledring: the LED sections, each with an optional own light entity (empty ones use "entity"). Without from/to there is one section per wall; with from/to (metres along the band from the first point) sections can sit anywhere, several per wall, gaps have no LEDs.

inset.description: Only for type ledring: distance from the room outline in metres (used when it is fitted to the room).

id.description: Optional name of this device inside the file, only needed as the target of another device's "feeds".

to.description: The "id" of another device in the file this one is wired to.

kind.description: What the cable carries (decides its colour): grid (connection to the public grid, feed-in), own solar, battery, load (consumption). Default: from the type of the device it starts at.

entity.description: Optional sensor (watts) of this cable; without it the sensor of the device it starts at is used.

route.description: floor: along the floor, then up; through: through the floors first, then along the floor of the target; air: free in the air.

cables.description: Power add-on: cables from this device to others (house connection -> meter cabinet -> inverter -> solar ...). The direction follows the sign of the value of "entity" (negative runs backwards). `feeds` (a single id) is the first version of this and still read.

batPower.description: Only for type battery: sensor for the charge / discharge power (plus = charging; or a text sensor with charging / discharging). "entity" is then the charge level in %.

batInvert.description: Only for type battery: turn the sign of the power sensor round (plus = discharging).

feeds.description: Old form of one cable in the air; use "cables".

legs.description: Only for type kitchenrun: the legs (straight, L, U) of the run, each a list of modules. A module is its name (standard width) or {"m": name, "w": width in metres}.

upper.description: Only for type kitchenrun: wall cabinets (default true).

depth.description: Only for type kitchenrun: depth of the cabinets in metres (default 0.6).

level.description: index of a floor in building.floors the roof sits on (default: on top of the building)
